The County Recorder in Mahnomen County is the custodian of all legal records pertaining to real estate, birth, death, marriage, ordination credentials, notary public registration, and State/Federal tax liens. NEW! The Mahnomen County Recorder’s Office is offering a new service to allow for viewing and/or printing real estate documents directly from your computer. The service is available 24 hours a day and seven days a week. Abstract documents are indexed from 1973 to present, by Grantor, Grantee, Document number, Instrument type, Document date and Recording date. Most 2007 to present documents also have legal descriptions and parcel ID numbers added. Prior to 1973 documents are indexed by Document number, book and page only. Torrens documents are indexed from 1974 to present. Prior to 1974 nothing indexed for Torrens. Please logon on to www.idocmarket.com to view the options to subscribe and for the fees. Contact Info Sharon Litzau, Mahnomen County Recorder Registrar of Titles Vital Statistics Registrar Mahnomen County Courthouse 311 North Main Street P.O. Box 380 Mahnomen MN 56557 Phone: 218-935-5528, Fax: 218-936-5656 E-mail: sharon.litzau@mahnomencounty.gov joann.doty@mahnomencounty.gov Search FAQs Recorder Real Estate Checks for recording real estate documents are sometimes distributed to different departments. Checks for State Deed Tax (SDT) and Mortgage Registry Tax (MRT) can be combined in one check. A separate check is needed for delinquent taxes, a separate check for current taxes and a separate check for recording fees. Make checks payable to Mahnomen County. If a deed is being eRecorded with a Well Certificate and a Certificate of Real Estate Value use the following sites to use the new eWell Certificate and the new eCRV. MN Department of Revenue MN Department of Health State Deed Tax (SDT) is figured at .0033 times exact consideration amount, with a minimum of $1.65 due if the total consideration is less than $3000. Mortgage Registry Tax (MRT) is figured as .0023 time’s exact amount of the mortgage. Make these checks payable to the Mahnomen County Treasurer. If numerous documents are submitted for recording with one check to cover all recording fees and any of the documents are not in recordable form, all documents will be returned without recording. We do not provide refund checks. Real estate documents are returned to the submitter unless an addressed, stamped envelope is submitted with the documents for the purpose of mailing the documents to a different party or address. Real Estate Recording Fees: $46 per document Satisfactions/Assignments $46 (This includes up to four document numbers referenced – an additional $10 per number thereafter) Well Disclosure Certificate $54 & Plat $56. eRecording in Mahnomen County We eRecord all abstract documents. We do not eRecord Torrens documents at this time. eRecording is the electronic process of receiving documents for recording. The documents are sent through a MN Trusted Submitter to our office where data is entered, payment is made, and the documents are electronically sent back in minutes fully recorded. Uniform commercial Code (UCC) filings Effective 12/1/2014, must be filed with the Secretary of State Central Notification System (CNS) Effective 2/1/2007, must be filed with the Secretary of State Birth Certificates To receive a certified birth certificate, you must have proof of tangible interest in the subject of the record. Certificates may be obtained by mail or in person. FEES: Certified: $26 first copy, each additional ordered at the same time $19 Non-certified: $13 per copy INFORMATION FOR REQUESTS BY MAIL: 1. Print Birth Certificate Application Form 2. Complete the form 3. Have your signature on the form notarized 4. Enclose check or money order payable to Mahnomen County Recorder 5. Mail to: P.O. Box 380, Mahnomen, MN 56557 You will be asked to complete and sign an application that you have tangible interest in the subject. You will need to provide a government issued picture ID to receive the certified birth certificate. Birth_Certificate_Apllication.pdf Death Certificates To receive a certified death certificate, you must have proof of tangible interest in the subject. FEES: Certified: $13 first copy/$6 each additional copy of the same certificate Non-certified: $13 per copy INFORMATION FOR REQUESTS BY MAIL: 1. Print Death Certificate Application Form 2. Complete the form 3. Have your signature on the form notarized 4. Enclose check or money order payable to Mahnomen County Recorder 5. Mail to Mahnomen County Recorder, P.O. Box 380, Mahnomen, MN 56557 WALK-IN REQUESTS: You will be asked to complete and sign an application stating that you have tangible interest in the subject. You will need to provide a government issued picture ID to receive the certified death certificate. Death_Certificate_Application.pdf Marriage License Application for a marriage license shall be made by both parties. If you have been previously married, please provide most current information. You will need to provide a government issued picture ID. The Marriage License is valid for a period of 6 months. The marriage license is valid only in the State of Minnesota. You do not need to be married in the Minnesota County from which you obtained you license. FEES: Marriage License - $125 Marriage License with pre-marital counseling - $50 Certified Marriage Certificate $9 each ONLINE APPLICATION at https://moms.mn.gov/application Statewide data base for all marriage records at www.moms.mn.gov Credentials of Ordination To perform a marriage in Minnesota, you must file your Credentials of Ordination or Credential of Licensing. This must be done in one of the counties in Minnesota prior to performing marriage ceremonies. Notary Public Information The Minnesota Secretary of State office (www.sos.state.mn.us) will issue a Notary Commission certificate. This certificate must be registered with your resident Minnesota County, in person. When you register with the county, please bring: 1. Notary Commission certificate from the Minnesota Secretary of State. 2. Government issued picture ID. 3. $20 fee. Share this page × Share this page Copy and paste this code into your website.
